stem: Joy got 34 items correct on a 40-item quiz. What percent of the items did she get correct?
hints: Write her score as a fraction: correct items over total items.
The fraction is 34/40. Simplify it by dividing the top and the bottom by 2.
34/40 = 17/20. Multiply the top and the bottom by 5 to make the bottom 100. The top is then the percent.

solution.methodName: What percent: part over whole, then make the bottom 100

steps.why: The part is what she got right. The whole is all the items on the quiz.

steps.action: Make the bottom 100: 20 × 5 = 100, so multiply the top by 5 too: 17 × 5 = 85. That gives 85/100.
85/100 = 85%. She got 85% of the items correct.

trapNotes.34%: This uses the score as the percent. The quiz has 40 items, not 100, so 34 right is not 34%.
trapNotes.68%: This doubles 34 as if the quiz had 50 items. With 40 items, simplify to 17/20 and multiply by 5.
trapNotes.15%: This is the percent she got wrong (6 out of 40). The question asks for the percent correct.
